summary.en: RNA interference is the common platform across Alnylam's pipeline, from late-stage TTR and hypertension programs to expanding neuroscience, metabolic and bleeding-disorder studies.
summary.zh: RNA 干扰是 Alnylam 整个管线的共同平台,涵盖从后期 TTR 和高血压项目,到不断扩展的神经科学、代谢和出血性疾病研究。

ind.en: Generalized myasthenia gravis; also PNH and geographic atrophy
ind.zh: 全身型重症肌无力;另有PNH和地图样萎缩

next.en: FDA decision on generalized myasthenia gravis NDA; target action date November 2026
next.zh: FDA对全身型重症肌无力新药申请的决定;目标行动日期为2026年11月

ind.en: ATTR cardiomyopathy; also hereditary ATTR polyneuropathy
ind.zh: ATTR心肌病;另有遗传性ATTR多发性神经病

next.en: Potential ATTR-CM launch by 2030, subject to positive data and regulatory approval
next.zh: 若数据积极并获监管批准,ATTR-CM有望于2030年前上市

ind.en: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy; also Alzheimer's disease
ind.zh: 脑淀粉样血管病;另有阿尔茨海默病

ind.en: Hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia; also von Willebrand disease
ind.zh: 遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症;另有血管性血友病

next.en: Phase 1 healthy-volunteer data at ASH in December; Phase 2 HHT results at full-year earnings in February 2027
next.zh: 12月ASH大会公布I期健康志愿者数据;2027年2月全年业绩公布时披露II期HHT结果

next.en: Initiate pivotal trial, pending regulatory alignment
next.zh: 启动关键性试验,待与监管机构达成一致
I 期结果将在全年业绩发布时公布

watch.en: TTR products generated $1.150 billion of $1.292 billion Q3 net product revenue.
watch.zh: 第三季度产品净收入 $1.292 billion,其中 TTR 产品贡献 $1.150 billion。

watch.en: Cemdisiran has a November 2026 FDA action date; ALN-6400 and obesity data are expected in February 2027.
watch.zh: Cemdisiran 的 FDA 行动日期为 2026 年 11 月;ALN-6400 和肥胖数据预计在 2027 年 2 月公布。

watch.en: Zilebesiran is partnered with Roche; Regeneron advances cemdisiran and collaborates on brezosiran.
watch.zh: Zilebesiran 与 Roche 合作;Regeneron 推进 cemdisiran,并就 brezosiran 开展合作。
